{{Quote|Come visit Mustafar, one of the hottest vacation destinations in the Galaxy! Ride a lava flea on an exciting volcanic tour or ride down the lava river on a heat shielded repulsorlift platform. Either way, a vacation to Mustafar is one you and your family will never forget!|A Mustafar Travel Advertisement|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''''Mustafar Travel Advertisement''''' was a title of an advertisement [[Painting/Legends|poster]] which sought to lure [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to the dangerous [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It was similar to the ''[[Hoth Travel Advertisement]]''.

The poster depicted the heat [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] platform, alongside a flowing river of lava with [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] in the background. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text read, "Visit the Wonder of Mustafar."

==Behind the scenes==
A ''Mustafar Travel Advertisement'' is a decorative item in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' which players can obtain as a loot item from the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.
